LaFondation.metaDescription: Mission, values, and history of Fondation Sarje, active with vulnerable families in Haiti.
LaFondation.missionBody: Fondation Sarje works with vulnerable families in Haiti so that every child has access to education, healthcare, and a stable environment, whatever their starting situation. We believe that close, sustained support can lasting change the course of a life.
LaFondation.histoireBody1: Born from a simple observation — too many children leave school or lack access to healthcare for want of resources — the foundation first supported a few families before structuring its work around programs dedicated to education, health, and community support.
LaFondation.histoireBody2: Today it relies on local teams, rooted in the communities they serve.
LaFondation.valeurProximiteBody: Our teams live and work in the communities they support, not remotely from an office.
LaFondation.valeurTransparenceBody: Every donation is tracked and accounted for, both to the families we support and to the partners who trust us.
LaFondation.valeurDureeBody: A child is supported over several years, not through one-off funding.
LaFondation.valeurDigniteBody: Support is built with families, never in their place. They remain in charge of their own choices.
